$comment: DERIVED, not verbatim. Written by this library from the prose of the W3C Recommendation Verifiable Credential Data Integrity 1.0 (REC-vc-data-integrity-20250515), which prints no JSON Schema, CDDL or ABNF of its own (README.md gives the search). Source .cache/w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0.bin, sha256 ba5c4baf13fe3bab3ebd95ab6650d6fe83720e254b383bb444b4fbbae7bcf4fe; quotations are cut from its rendering .cache/w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0.txt, sha256 2b7725f80e138ef943eff25050eee6a62f8887762ca9e1e03867c55ea5647beb, and cite its line numbers (L). LEVELS: the root and every anchor not ending in -should state MUST and MUST NOT rules, so a failure there is non-conformance; an anchor ending in -should adds SHOULD statements and includes the root by reference, so a failure there is a warning. MAY statements are never constraints: a leniency a MAY grants has its own anchor, named for the leniency. A constraint marked INFERRED is a reading this library made, not a statement of the source; one marked OUTSIDE-SOURCE comes from a document the source names and is not this source's. Rule ids (P-nn, S-nn, V-nn, E-nn, O-nn, M-nn) are those of rules.derived.yaml. INSTANCE: the structs the algorithms return, written as JSON objects (a document is a map, a list of ProblemDetails is an array). ROOT = the verification result of Verify Proof (4.4). ANCHORS: #cryptosuite-result (section 3), #error-raised (the result a step that says an error MUST be raised returns), #combined-as-written (section 4.5 exactly as written, with its field names, README T-05), #context-validation-result (4.6) and #context-validation-failed. warnings and errors default to an empty list, so neither is required.
title: The result structs of the Data Integrity algorithms (DERIVED)

verifiedDocument.$comment: V-02 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0065: “verifiedDocument Null, if verified is false; otherwise, an input document” (L591-592) An object, or null. “A map that represents the secured data document with the verified proofs removed if verified is true, or null otherwise.” (L506)

mediaType.$comment: V-03 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0065: “mediaType Null, if verified is false; otherwise, a media type, which MAY include parameters” (L593-594) A string, or null.

warnings.$comment: V-04 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0065: “warnings a list of ProblemDetails, which defaults to an empty list” (L595-596)

errors.$comment: V-05 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0065: “errors a list of ProblemDetails, which defaults to an empty list” (L597-598)

cryptosuite.$comment: ANCHOR #cryptosuite-result. The struct: “The cryptosuite verification result is a struct that contains the following items:” (L502) verified is a boolean; verifiedDocument is a map when verified is true and null otherwise (L506). Other members are allowed (MAY): w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0045: “The structure MAY contain other implementation-specific information that is useful for developers, such as debugging information.” (L507)

errorRaised.$comment: ANCHOR #error-raised. V-06 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0065: “When a step says "an error MUST be raised", it means that a verification result MUST be returned with a verified value of false and a non-empty errors list.” (L599) So: verified false, errors non-empty, and (by V-02, V-03) no document and no media type.

combined.$comment: ANCHOR #combined-as-written. Section 4.5 (I-12) names the combined result's members status, document and mediaType (L630) and then sets and tests verified (L632), and section 4.4's result has verified, verifiedDocument and mediaType: the algorithm uses status and verified for one member and document and verifiedDocument for another. This anchor takes the as-written names and treats status and verified as two spellings of the one boolean. README T-05. “Let combinedVerificationResult be an empty struct. Set combinedVerificationResult.status to true, combinedVerificationResult.document to null, and combinedVerificationResult.mediaType to null.” (L630)

ctxResult.$comment: ANCHOR #context-validation-result. Section 4.6 (I-13): validated, validatedDocument, warnings, errors. “Null, if validated is false; otherwise, an input document” (L644) “If result.errors is empty, set result.validated to true” (L655).

ctxFailed.$comment: ANCHOR #context-validation-failed. “If result.errors is empty, set result.validated to true; otherwise, set result.validated to false, and remove the document property from result.” (L655) Removing the property and the struct's “Null, if validated is false” (L644) disagree on absent against null: README T-06. validatedDocument is therefore absent or null, never a document.
